choices.reason: No rule separates these candidates: the paper presents Claude Opus 4.5, Gemini 3 Pro, and GPT-5.2 as parallel judges of the same final-story creativity contrast, using identical prompts, and names none as primary or the main specification. None supplies participant-level statistics or data_stats permitting a standardized effect, and the sample, arms, task and timing are identical across candidates, so the remaining rules do not resolve the tie.
